name: profile-load-hotfix-public-linked-studio
description: Verify a Studio session linked to the published place defaults to an ephemeral profile and cannot fail closed on disabled Studio API access.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local Players=game:GetService('Players')
local deadline=os.clock()+20
local player=Players:GetPlayers()[1]
repeat
 task.wait(.05)
 player=Players:GetPlayers()[1]
until os.clock()>=deadline or (player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true)
local root=workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG')
local mode=root and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode') or ''
local defaultEphemeral=root and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true
local liveOptIn=root and root:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==true
local ready=player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true
local writable=player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==true
local state=player and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState') or ''
local ok=mode=='EphemeralStudio' and defaultEphemeral and not liveOptIn and ready and not writable and state=='EphemeralStudio'
return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,mode=mode,defaultEphemeral=defaultEphemeral,liveOptIn=liveOptIn,ready=ready,writable=writable,state=state})

steps.label: linked Studio receives a ready non-writable ephemeral profile

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio() and p,'isolated Studio client required')
local function formatNumber(value)
 value=tonumber(value) or 0
 local abs=math.abs(value)
 if abs>=1e12 then return string.format('%.1fT',value/1e12)
 elseif abs>=1e9 then return string.format('%.1fB',value/1e9)
 elseif abs>=1e6 then return string.format('%.1fM',value/1e6)
 elseif abs>=1e3 then return string.format('%.1fK',value/1e3) end
 return tostring(math.floor(value+.5))
end
local function finite(value)return type(value)=='number' and value==value and value>-math.huge and value<math.huge end
local started=os.clock()
local deadline=started+25
local observedRemote,connection,payload
local events=0
local result={ok=false}
local function disconnect()
 if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
 return connection==nil or connection.Connected==false
end
local function inspect()
 local folder=RS:FindFirstChild('PunchWallEvents')
 local remotes={}
 local complete=folder~=nil and folder:IsA('Folder') and folder.Parent==RS
 for _,name in ipairs({'Notify','StatsChanged','ActionRequest','Feedback'})do
  local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
  local valid=remote~=nil and remote:IsA('RemoteEvent') and remote.Parent==folder
  remotes[name]={class=remote and remote.ClassName or 'Missing',currentParent=valid}
  complete=complete and valid
 end
 local stat=complete and folder:FindFirstChild('StatsChanged') or nil
 if stat~=observedRemote then
  assert(disconnect(),'previous StatsChanged observer did not disconnect')
  connection=nil observedRemote=stat payload=nil
  if stat then connection=stat.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(value)
   if RS:FindFirstChild('PunchWallEvents')==folder and stat.Parent==folder and type(value)=='table' then
    payload=value events+=1
   end
  end)end
 end
 local playerGui=p:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
 local gui=playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild('PunchWallHUD')
 local hud=gui and gui:FindFirstChild('PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD')
 local automation=gui and gui:FindFirstChild('PunchWallClientAutomation')
 local stats=p:FindFirstChild('RPGStats')
 local leader=p:FindFirstChild('leaderstats')
 local function value(name)local item=stats and stats:FindFirstChild(name) or leader and leader:FindFirstChild(name)return item and item.Value end
 local valuesMatch=type(payload)=='table'
 for _,name in ipairs({'Power','Coins','Depth','WallLevel'})do
  valuesMatch=valuesMatch and finite(payload[name]) and payload[name]==value(name)
 end
 valuesMatch=valuesMatch and finite(payload.EffectivePower) and payload.EffectivePower>0
 local power=hud and hud:FindFirstChild('PowerValue',true)
 local coins=hud and hud:FindFirstChild('CoinsValue',true)
 local hudReady=gui~=nil and gui:IsA('ScreenGui') and gui.Enabled and hud~=nil and hud.Visible
 local reflectsSnapshot=valuesMatch and power~=nil and power:IsA('TextLabel') and power.Visible
  and coins~=nil and coins:IsA('TextLabel') and coins.Visible
  and power.Text==formatNumber(payload.EffectivePower) and coins.Text==formatNumber(payload.Coins)
  and finite(payload.TutorialVersion) and payload.TutorialVersion>=1
  and gui:GetAttribute('OnboardingTutorialVersion')==payload.TutorialVersion
 local snapshot,snapshotError
 if hudReady and reflectsSnapshot and automation and automation:IsA('BindableFunction') then
  local called,received=pcall(function()return automation:Invoke('Snapshot')end)
  if called then snapshot=received else snapshotError=tostring(received):sub(1,300)end
 end
 local snapshotReady=type(snapshot)=='table' and snapshot.ok==true and type(snapshot.inventory)=='table' and snapshot.inventory.ok==true
  and type(snapshot.viewport)=='table' and finite(snapshot.viewport.x) and snapshot.viewport.x>1 and finite(snapshot.viewport.y) and snapshot.viewport.y>1
  and type(snapshot.position)=='table'
 local profileReady=p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false
  and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio'
 return {ok=complete and hudReady and reflectsSnapshot and snapshotReady and profileReady and game.Players.LocalPlayer==p and p.Parent==game.Players,
  remotes=remotes,remotesReady=complete,hudReady=hudReady,profileReady=profileReady,
  authoritativeSnapshotReceived=events>0,authoritativeValuesMatch=valuesMatch,hudReflectsSnapshot=reflectsSnapshot,
  clientSnapshotReady=snapshotReady,snapshotError=snapshotError,observedSnapshots=events,
  powerText=power and power.Text or '',coinText=coins and coins.Text or ''}
end
local called,failure=xpcall(function()
 repeat
  result=inspect()
  if result.ok then break end
  task.wait(.05)
 until os.clock()>=deadline
end,function(err)return tostring(err):sub(1,800)end)
local clean,disconnected=pcall(disconnect)
result.observerDisconnected=clean and disconnected==true
result.elapsed=os.clock()-started
result.timedOut=not result.ok and result.elapsed>=25
result.ok=called and result.ok==true and result.observerDisconnected and result.elapsed<=25.1
if not called then result.error=failure end
if not clean then result.cleanupError=tostring(disconnected):sub(1,300)end
local encoded=H:JSONEncode(result)
assert(#encoded<3500,'client startup diagnostic exceeds evidence bound')
return encoded
